intro.label: Our history
intro.title: An institution serving northern Paraguay
intro.body1: The Universidad Nacional de Concepción was established by Law No. 3,201 on July 4, 2007, with the purpose of providing quality public higher education to the northern region of the Republic of Paraguay. Located in the city of Concepción, capital of the Concepción Department, UNC responds to the community's long-standing demand for higher education close to its reality.
intro.body2: With six faculties and a broad academic offering, the institution trains professionals committed to the region's sustainable development, fostering research, university outreach, and innovation as pillars of academic life.

mission.label: Regional mission
mission.title: Committed to northern Paraguay
mission.body: The Universidad Nacional de Concepción defines itself as a public higher education institution at the service of Paraguayan society, with special emphasis on the needs of the northern region. Its mission is the comprehensive training of professionals capable of contributing to the economic, social, and cultural development of the region, through teaching, scientific research, and university outreach.
